buildCommand: if [ -n "$CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY" ]; then npx convex deploy --cmd 'npm run build'; elif [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then echo 'CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY is missing in production. Refusing to build a frontend with no backend.'; exit 1; else npm run build; fi
ignoreCommand: PREV="${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-HEAD^}"; git cat-file -e "$PREV^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || exit 1; git diff --quiet "$PREV" HEAD -- . ':(exclude)docs' ':(exclude)data' ':(exclude)*.md'
